feature_contract.goal: Prevent dead OpenXR host persistent IPC state from changing OutRun original menu/game pixels while D3D9Ex CreateDevice retains a different stereo source size.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Opt-in VRAutoRenderResolution only: game config through R84 CreateDevice, preserving explicit manual/CLI sizes, R26_SAFE rollback, original input/FFB/SkyGlow, DX11 and DXVK freeze.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Verified source discrepancy on GitHub head: hooks_misc.cpp trusts nonzero hostPid and persistent HostAlive flag without verifying that the process still exists, but ex_device_upgrade.cpp refuses dead host PID at D3D9Ex CreateDevice. A crashed host leaves a mapping with stale XR resolution; early menu gets wrong aspect and late source stays original.
trace_stages: Game config reads a persistent HostState.v3 eye extent after host launch request but before original menu resources are authored.
Shared nonblocking Win32 process-liveness and binocular coherent extent check now admits XR pixels at game-config and CreateDevice boundaries.
Valid XR source proceeds to R84 independent R29-R33 stereo renderer and per-eye OpenXR host, with desktop/manual and classic D3D9 fallback retained.
subcomponents: Repair early menu/game original screen_resolution assignment with real OS host PID and binocular eye extent ownership.
Preserve late D3D9Ex device-caps admission using the same helper and validate dead PID, cleared flags, malformed pixel pair, good paired PID regressions.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Original game config/menu and XR eye-source selection
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Dead host process cannot resize OutRun screen_resolution; a live OS host and coherent binocular XR pixels can.
Live PID and coherent pixels are required at both boundaries and invalid XR data leaves original source and classic fallback intact.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows game R84 x86 and x64 OpenXR host package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All exact-SHA required DX9Ex Active, Domain, source impact gates pass; Quest3 hardware stays untested.

diagnosis.observed_defect: Proven inconsistent source configuration after stale persistent host flags; no HMD repro claimed.
source_trace: Game INI uses persistent HostState without OS liveness
Original menu screen_resolution changed before CreateDevice
D3D9Ex CreateDevice separately rejects dead PID resulting in inconsistent native source.
alternatives_rejected: Explicit CLI/manual override already handled, and DXVK/FFB/SkyGlow are unrelated to this source configuration mismatch.
diagnosis.original_evidence: Source-confirmed mismatch in GitHub at 2026-10-16, independent of any Quest3 optical claim.
